Name: Global Keg Chest
Author: xx2918
Description:
Global Keg Chest

Place keg ingredients in a Global Keg Chest. The mod automatically supplies placed vanilla kegs across locations and collects their finished products. The chest and kegs do not need to be adjacent, and each keg needs no individual setup.

Features
• 70 slots shared by ingredients and finished products.
• Works with vanilla kegs across locations, including building interiors and Ginger Island.
• Multiple Global Keg Chests keep separate inventories while serving the same kegs.
• If the chests are full, finished products remain in their kegs.
• Uses the game's normal keg recipes and processing times.
• English and Simplified Chinese names follow the game's language setting.

Crafting
The recipe unlocks at Farming level 8. It requires 150 Wood, 3 Copper Bars, 1 Iron Bar, 1 Oak Resin, 1 Battery Pack, and 1 Iridium Bar.

Installation
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer. Close the game, then extract the download into Stardew Valley/Mods. Check that Mods/GlobalKegChest/manifest.json exists, and launch the game through SMAPI. Content Patcher and SpaceCore are not required.

Compatibility
This mod automates vanilla kegs only. It does not automate casks, preserves jars, or custom machines with different IDs. In multiplayer, only the host runs the automation. Two-player sessions, split-screen, remote opening through Chests Anywhere, and simultaneous use with Automate have not yet been manually tested. Local testing was done on Windows. Please include your game version, SMAPI version, reproduction steps, and a SMAPI log when reporting a problem.

中文

把小桶可加工的原料放进全域酿造箱，它会跨地点为已放置的原版小桶自动装料，并收回完成的产物。箱子无需靠近小桶，也不用逐个设置小桶。

功能
• 箱子有 70 格，原料与成品共用空间。
• 支持不同地点的原版小桶，包括建筑内部和姜岛。
• 多只全域酿造箱各自保存库存，共同服务小桶。
• 箱子装满时，成品会留在小桶里。
• 遵循游戏原有的小桶配方与加工时间。
• 名称和说明随游戏语言在英语、简体中文之间切换。

制作
耕种达到 8 级后解锁配方。需要木材 ×150、铜锭 ×3、铁锭 ×1、橡树树脂 ×1、电池组 ×1、铱锭 ×1。

安装
需要《星露谷物语》1.6.15 或更新版本，以及 SMAPI 4.5.2 或更新版本。关闭游戏，将下载的压缩包解压到 Stardew Valley/Mods，确认 Mods/GlobalKegChest/manifest.json 存在，再通过 SMAPI 启动。无需安装 Content Patcher 或 SpaceCore。

兼容性
本 Mod 只处理原版小桶，不处理陈酿桶、罐头瓶或使用其他 ID 的自定义机器。联机时仅房主执行自动化。双人联机、分屏、通过 Chests Anywhere 远程开箱，以及与 Automate 同时使用，目前尚未完成手动测试。本机测试环境为 Windows。反馈问题时请附游戏版本、SMAPI 版本、复现步骤和 SMAPI 日志。
